lina: Quick heads-up — seeing a ~6% exact-match drop for the quantized 13B run on SQuAD in the new harness. Repro on my laptop, but only for certain examples.
omar: ugh. any sample fails?
lina: yeah, here's one example where gold vs pred look identical to the eye but EM=false:
lina: `gold: "O’Connor"`
lina: `pred: "O'Connor"`
omar: that’s a unicode quote vs ascii apostrophe. harness normalizes whitespace but not unicode.
marta: we do have a strip-and-lower pipeline step, but I don’t think we run unicodedata.normalize anywhere.
lina: pasted a quick diff I used locally to normalize refs+preds to NFKC and strip zero-widths — fixed most of the false negatives:
lina: ```py
+import unicodedata, re
+ZWS = "\u200b"
+def canonicalize(s):
+    if s is None: return ""
+    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', s)
+    s = s.replace(ZWS, '')
+    s = re.sub(r"\\s+", ' ', s).strip()
+    return s
+
+# apply to both reference and prediction before token/EM checks
```
devan: good call. but there's another wrinkle: runner currently tokenizes the reference with the model tokenizer when computing span EM, while our canonical EM should use the dataset canonicalizer (sentencepiece-free). That mismatch inflates diffs for models using SentencePiece vs BPE.
omar: wait, that's a bug — model_tokenizer vs canonical_tokenizer? where is that wiring?
lin: in eval_runner/eval_metrics.py: there's a call `tokenizer.encode(ref)` inside compute_exact_match — easy to miss. I swapped it to `canonical_tokenizer.encode(ref)` and re-ran.
lin: minimal patch I applied locally:```diff
-    ref_tokens = tokenizer.encode(ref)
+    # use dataset canonicalizer to avoid model-specific tokenization drift
+    ref_tokens = canonical_tokenizer.encode(canonicalize(ref))
```
evalbot: CI alert: metrics-reporter failed on last job with "invalid literal for float(): 'nan'" while serializing BERTScore mean.
marta: that happened when a batch had all-empty preds after aggressive truncation — BERTScore returns nan for F1.
omar: reporter should sanitize NaN -> 0.0 and emit warning, not crash the job. small change in reporter formatters.
lin: I added a small guard in my branch and also a unit test that feeds combining diacritics and zero-width spaces through canonicalize + exact_match.
lin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8342 — includes canonicalize, tokenizer fix, NaN guard, and a couple of smoke tests.
devan: can you add a short note in the changelog about normalization so future model onboarding ppl don't trip?
lin: yes — will add a short section under eval-harness/CHANGELOG.md and ping workspace.
marta: nice. can you also add a tiny CI job that runs against a known SQuAD seed with quantized weights? catches regressions quickly.
omar: +1 for canary job. i'll schedule a tiny ephemeral GPU job.
lin: cool — will merge after green canary. thanks all :thumbsup:
